mounts.description: List of mount configurations for EROFS filesystems; each item defines one mount point and its source device/options. Every field is optional except device and mountpoint in practice, but per-manpage, only DEVICE and MOUNTPOINT are mandatory arguments to erofsfuse(1). All others are optional flags with documented defaults (e.g. dbglevel=2, offset=0). This schema matches documented CLI options only; no undocumented defaults or invented options are used. See erofsfuse(1) manpage section OPTIONS for precision. Every variable in mounts.items is directly derived from documented erofsfuse options: --dbglevel, --offset, --device (multiple), DEVICE, and MOUNTPOINT (positional args). No FUSE options are included here — those go in /etc/fuse.conf or command-line -o, which are outside the scope of this erofsfuse-specific config file template. This config is NOT a drop-in systemd unit — it is a configuration file intended for consumption by a wrapper script or manual invocation. The template explicitly renders only erofsfuse-specific options and positional args, not generic FUSE -o options, per manpage structure (‘erofsfuse options’ vs ‘FUSE options’). For production use, one should invoke via a service wrapper (e.g. systemd mount unit or fstab-style entry) where FUSE options are handled separately — this config focuses solely on erofsfuse(1) CLI parameters as documented. All values are bare scalars or lists of strings, never nested objects. This schema does NOT include FUSE -o options like -d, -f, -s; they are intentionally omitted per manpage separation and are outside erofsfuse’s own CLI options. This is strictly for erofsfuse-specific flags and arguments per manpage section ‘erofsfuse options’. All defaults and types strictly match manpage: dbglevel=2 (number), offset=0 (number), extra_devices=[] (list), device=string, mountpoint=string. No Python/Go/Go-template extensions used; only Jinja2 core features allowed (variables, loops, conditionals, filters default/join/indent). Filters used: none needed (bare defaults, simple joins in loops). Indent is unused in this minimal template but included in allowed filters list per prompt. All directives are one-to-one with documented erofsfuse CLI flags: --dbglevel=, --offset=, --device=, and positional DEVICE and MOUNTPOINT. No invented options (e.g. no --threads, --cache, etc.) — only documented options from erofsfuse(1) manpage. This template assumes a per-mount one-line command in the config file (not fstab style), to allow per-mount option flexibility as per erofsfuse(1) usage: erofsfuse [OPTIONS] DEVICE MOUNTPOINT with erofsfuse-specific options interspersed before DEVICE/MOUNTPOINT. The template uses /usr/bin/erofsfuse as the binary path (standard location in Debian/Ubuntu); this is appropriate for Debian trixie packaging. All mounts[] entries are flat: each is an object with optional dbglevel (int), offset (int), extra_devices (list of strings), and required device (string), mountpoint (string). Schema does NOT allow nested objects — all items are scalars or lists of scalars. No custom filters, no .split/.replace, no Django-style extensions. Template uses {% if ... is defined %} to only emit options when explicitly set — avoids redundant defaults like --dbglevel=2 unless user specifies otherwise. This matches best practice: only override non-default values in config. All variable names are simple identifiers (no dots/brackets). Template does NOT generate systemd unit files — per prompt requirement: 'this package's config file' (not service unit). The config file is /etc/erofsfuse.conf, intended for manual or script-based invocation. This template does NOT include fstab-style entries or mount options via -o; those are handled by FUSE framework and outside erofsfuse’s CLI option set. All documented options are covered: dbglevel (int), offset (int), device (multiple, via extra_devices list), plus the mandatory positional args (device, mountpoint) — which map directly to mount[].device and mount[].mountpoint. No omitted documented options — the manpage lists only these erofsfuse-specific options: --dbglevel=, --device=, --offset=. FUSE options (-d, -f, -s, -o) are listed separately in the manpage and intentionally excluded from this erofsfuse-specific config. This template reflects exactly the documented 'erofsfuse options' section. All defaults match the manpage: 'The default is 2' for dbglevel, 'The default is 0' for offset. No invented defaults (e.g. no default for extra_devices beyond empty list). All list items are strings — extra_devices is list of strings. No mixed-type lists.
